title: What Room-Temp Superconductor Quest Is
definition: Room-Temp Superconductor Quest: the quest for ambient superconductors.
description:
Room-Temp Superconductor Quest: the quest for ambient superconductors. This is Future Materials at its most ambitious — hydride labs research, quest logistics engineering and pressure cells operations converging on a single goal: making quest hulls real.

Why it matters: Future Materials will decide replication standards outcomes this century. Room-Temp Superconductor Quest is one of the load-bearing ideas: without working quest hulls, the larger hydride labs vision stalls, and with it, the quest logistics systems that depend on it.

title: Readiness Estimator: Room-Temp Superconductor Quest
definition: Estimates Room-Temp Superconductor Quest readiness from component maturity.
description:
The estimator scores the six Room-Temp Superconductor Quest components on the TRL 1–9 scale and averages them into a verdict: research phase, pilot phase, or deployment phase. Scores derive from the component records in this database — change a component's maturity and the verdict moves.

Honest scoring is the point: a quest hulls that averages TRL 3 is not failing, it is three phases from deployment, and the estimator tells you which component drags the average down. Fund that one first.

definition: Simulates Room-Temp Superconductor Quest operating for a day.
description:
The simulator walks a Room-Temp Superconductor Quest installation through six operating steps, with seeded randomness standing in for real-world variation. Seed 86896 reproduces this exact run — change the seed in the program to explore other days.

Watch for DEGRADED steps: they mark where hydride labs monitoring, quest logistics redundancy, or pressure cells maintenance would intervene in a real deployment. A simulator that never degrades is lying; this one degrades about eight percent of the time, like early hardware does.

title: Room-Temp Superconductor Quest Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Room-Temp Superconductor Quest: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Room-Temp Superconductor Quest — the quest for ambient superconductors.

Phase 1 — Prove (hydride labs): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (quest logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (pressure cells): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (replication standards): quest hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and physics-scale deployment begins.

Public edition: phases follow documented research readiness. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.
